header.title: Versioned provider components
header.description: Packages are checked for signature, manifest, component format and permitted imports before the atomic installation. Unsigned packages only work when the service runs in explicit development mode.

install.label: .rdplug package
install.hint: Maximum 65 MiB; binary data is not stored as a temporary upload.

installed.title: Local inventory
installed.empty: No plugins installed yet. Hoster links need a resolver plugin: install a service from the bundle above or from a repository.

card.author: by {author}
card.concurrency_hint: At most {count} downloads run through this plugin at the same time
card.superseded_hint: Another version of this plugin is loaded instead. It stays on disk while unfinished work is still bound to it, and can be removed otherwise.
card.active_version_hint: This is the version being loaded.
card.withdrawn_hint: This build is refused from the next start on; the signing key is untouched.

keys.title: Confirmed publishers
keys.description: Plugins from third parties are signed with their author’s own key. A key you confirm here stays trusted until you revoke it; revoking one disables its plugins from the next restart.
keys.empty: No third-party signing keys confirmed. Only plugins signed with the release key are accepted.

trust.warning: Only confirm if this fingerprint matches the one published by the plugin’s author. A wrong key lets someone else ship updates for this plugin.

incompatible.title: Installed but not runnable
incompatible.description: These packages are on disk but this version cannot run them. They are left alone until you remove them — deleting them automatically would only make a hoster disappear without explanation. A package that needs a newer build works again once its author rebuilds it.

reason.plugin.manifest_outdated: Built for an older plugin contract. The author has to rebuild it for this version.
reason.plugin.capability_unknown: Asks for a permission or plugin type this version does not know.
reason.plugin.manifest_unreadable: The manifest cannot be read at all; the package is damaged.

remove.title: Delete plugin?
remove.description: “{name}” is removed from disk. Getting it back means installing it again.
remove.superseded_description: Version {version} of “{name}” is removed from disk. Version {active} stays installed and keeps being loaded.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this build?
withdraw.intro: “{name}” {version} is refused by its exact package content, not by its version number.
withdraw.restart: It keeps running until the service restarts; from the next start it is skipped.
withdraw.key_untouched: The signing key stays trusted. Every other plugin signed with it, and every other version of this one, keeps loading.
withdraw.reason_hint: Kept as written and shown beside the entry.

withdrawn.title: Packages this machine refuses
withdrawn.description: A withdrawal takes effect at the next start: a package already loaded keeps running until then and is skipped from then on. Only this one build is affected — the signing key stays trusted, and every other plugin signed with it keeps loading.
withdrawn.empty: No package is withdrawn. Every installed version that verifies is loaded.
withdrawn.not_installed: This package is not installed here; its digest is all that identifies it.

versions.title: Versions
versions.staged_hint: Only downloads started with this version on purpose run it, until you activate it.
versions.auto_update_hint: Otherwise an update is shown and installed when you click it. Either way it becomes active at a restart.

preview.title: Review before installing
preview.author: Author: {author}

key.trusted: Signed with a key you already trust.
key.untrusted: Signed with a key this installation has not seen before. Installing trusts it.
key.mismatch: The key id belongs to a different trusted key. This package cannot be installed.
key.withdrawn: A plugin repository withdrew this signing key. This package cannot be installed.
key.unsigned: Unsigned package; only a development installation accepts it.

preview.withdrawn: This exact package was withdrawn and cannot be installed.
preview.restart: A plugin becomes active after the next restart.
preview.no_added_permissions: Asks for nothing v{version} does not already have.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Newer versions from the enabled repositories, signed with the key the installed version is signed with. Nothing installs without your review unless a plugin is set to update automatically.
updates.empty: Every installed plugin is up to date.
updates.automatic_hint: Installed by the next check; active after a restart.
updates.available_empty: The repositories offer nothing that is not installed here.
updates.adds_permissions_hint: Asks for more than the installed version, so it installs only after your review, even when updates are automatic.

repositories.title: Plugin repositories
repositories.description: A repository only delivers packages: each one still has to be signed by a plugin key you trust. Switching a repository off stops its updates and offers and keeps what was installed from it.
repositories.interval_hint: Between 1 and 168 hours. The first check runs shortly after the service starts.
repositories.key_hint: As the repository’s publisher publishes it. Compare the fingerprint shown next before you approve it.
repositories.approve_intro: The index at {url} is signed with this key and offers {count} packages.
repositories.approve_warning: Only approve if this fingerprint matches the one the repository’s publisher published. The repository may then offer packages and withdraw what it delivered; every package still needs a plugin key you trust.
repositories.remove_description: {name} will no longer offer updates. Plugins installed from it stay installed.

bundled.title: Available services
bundled.description: What this release ships but is not installed — not chosen, removed or new. One click installs a service with all its plugins; they run from the next start.
bundled.all_installed: Everything in the bundle is installed.
bundled.none: This build ships no bundle. Plugins then come from a repository.
bundled.installed: Nothing installed. | 1 plugin installed; it runs from the next start. | {count} plugins installed; they run from the next start.
bundled.installed_live: Nothing installed. | 1 plugin installed; it runs now. | {count} plugins installed; they run now.
